name: king_cobra_fight
description: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah): heavy olive #6b7a3a body, darker olive back #4f5a2a, thin pale cream chevron bands #e8e0a8 pointing toward the head and fading toward it, pale yellow throat #e8d890, large smooth head shields, small dark eye under a heavy brow, NARROW hood (barely wider than the neck; never the wide Naja disc). Two adult king cobras locked in a fight: bodies crossed in a tangle, each with its jaws clamped on the other's neck (no wounds, no blood), tails splayed left and right. The right/upper one is slightly smaller and a touch darker. Anchor centre; bbox x -392..+390, y -224..+223.
